whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Rasoi Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has an incredible 4.2★ reputation with over 1,340 reviews in Kidwaipuri, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, digital menu, aur table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/rasoi

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Rasoi Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Rasoi Restaurant in Kidwaipuri) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering, digital menu, and table booking features for your Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, prices aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
